audience: loyalty programme teams that show rewards and customer wallets to their members with White Label Loyalty

useCases.title: Show the rewards a customer can buy
useCases.text: List the rewards and their points cost. Pass the customer's token to see the rewards that customer may view, and hide rewards that cannot be bought.

useCases.title: Check a customer's points, tier and vouchers
useCases.text: Read the wallet of the customer behind the token: points balance, tier, progress to the next tier and vouchers. Read the spend and earn caps too.

useCases.title: Buy a reward for a customer who asked for it
useCases.text: Purchase a reward for the customer behind the token. If the reward costs points, those points are deducted. A repeat call buys again, so call it once.
